task: We want to add 20 charging points by 1 March 2027. Using the observed usage data, which existing sites/areas show the highest saturation and are the best candidates? Give a ranked shortlist with the data behind it.
markdown:
## Answer
BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 shows the highest saturation among well-observed sites, with occupancy of 66.9% and all points busy 46.2% of the time [E2]. BZ_BOEHLER_01, BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02, BZ_P_VITTORIA and BZ_PIAVE_01 follow as the best-supported candidates. All figures are indicative because coverage is low everywhere [E4].

## Key findings
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (2 points): occupancy 66.9%, full_time 46.2%, 203 observed_starts, exposure 197.89 h, coverage 14.7% [E2].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 (1 point) has the highest full_time at 57.0% (occupancy also 57.0%), with 170 observed_starts and the best coverage among the top sites at 22.7% [E2, E3].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 (2 points): occupancy 51.9%, full_time 30.1%, and the most observed_starts among the top 8 at 261 [E2].
- BZ_P_VITTORIA (3 points): occupancy 63.5%, full_time 27.7%, 135 observed_starts, but coverage only 8.2% with 757 gaps over 120 min [E2, E4].
- BZ_PIAVE_01 (2 points): occupancy 50.8%, full_time 29.9%, 212 observed_starts, coverage 16.0%, peak hour 23:00 [E2].
- BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 (occupancy 56.1%, 53 starts, coverage 4.4%) and BZ_RESSEL_01 (occupancy 52.2%, 46 starts, coverage 3.3%) look saturated but have too little exposure to rank confidently [E2, E3].
- Both RISPARMIO sites sit in the top 6 by occupancy with 203 and 261 observed_starts, suggesting a cluster. This is inferred from site names only; no distance data was available [E2].

## Recommendation
Shortlist, best-supported first:
1. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01
2. BZ_BOEHLER_01
3. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02
4. BZ_P_VITTORIA
5. BZ_PIAVE_01

Prioritise the RISPARMIO area as the first expansion zone, then BZ_BOEHLER_01. Treat BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 and BZ_RESSEL_01 as watch-list sites until more data is collected. Before committing all 20 points by 1 March 2027, verify site capacity and the location of the RISPARMIO sites on the ground.

## Limitations & unknowns
- Metrics show occupancy only, not energy, official sessions, demand or faults [E1].
- Coverage is low everywhere, from 4.4% to 22.7% among the top sites, and each of the top 5 has hundreds of gaps over 120 min [E4].
- Most top sites have only 1–3 points, so high saturation is easy to reach at small sites [E2].
- The data do not say how many points to add at each site; the split of the 20 points is unavailable.
- 22 sites were excluded for under 24 h of exposure, so their saturation is unknown [E2].
- No cluster geography or distance data was available.

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=full_time) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E4] data_quality — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14

- **Main caveat:** Rankings rest on 3.3–22.7% coverage over about two months, with occupancy only (no energy, sessions or demand), so the ordering is indicative and a 20-point commitment should wait for on-site validation.
- **Small-site bias:** Top sites have 1–3 points, so saturation (e.g. 57.0%, 66.9%) is easy to reach and may not justify adding capacity.
